Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Mars, Uranus And The Demon Star", "body": "Berkana opens by zooming out on the Mars and Uranus conjunction that fell in Taurus on the fixed star Algol, noting that the two planets meet roughly every eighteen or nineteen months, so the pairing itself is not rare. She describes Mars as everything from a sword to blood to a scalpel to an explosion, and Uranus as a Promethean, rebellious impulse toward individuality rather than a collectivist one. People feel a transit like that most, she argues, when it resonates with their own nativity, especially if they carry the same conjunction, opposition or square."}, {"title": "How A Hellenistic Astrologer Reads An Event", "body": "Asked what she would tell a client about the July rally shooting, Berkana walks through her method: first the perfection year and its time lord, then the houses. She notes Trump was in a seventh house year ruled by Saturn, which sits in Cancer in his twelfth and is therefore debilitated, and reads that as partners whose interests are hidden rather than open. She adds that the conjunction fell exactly on his midheaven and squared his natal Mars in the first house. Pressed by Garton for anything supporting a staged reading, she says she would want Neptune or a weakened Mercury, and does not see it."}, {"title": "Paris, Achilles And Turning It On Its Ear", "body": "The co-host who broadcasts as Slick Dissident maps the moment onto myth and wordplay, comparing a shot from a distance to Paris killing Achilles with an arrow from the walls of Troy, cowardly archery set against face to face spearsmanship, then tying Paris back to the Apple of Discord that started the Trojan War. He layers on the English idiom to turn something on its ear, the Old Testament rite of piercing a servant's ear, and a dry stretch of the Ars Goetia that reads birth defects as auguries, which he suspects functioned as a self fulfilling prophecy."}, {"title": "Algol As A Shield Rather Than A Threat", "body": "Berkana argues Algol has more than one face. Two sidereal astrologers she follows treat it as a financial star, which makes it worth asking who gained from a sudden, shocking, bloody event, but she is more interested in the fact that Medusa's head becomes the shield of Perseus once it is severed, so Algol can be used protectively if it is used consciously. She recounts camping through the previous Mars and Uranus conjunction with a tornado a kilometre away, taking extra precautions, and closes by telling listeners that the scariest transits are usually nothing burgers."}, {"title": "Baby Charts And The Jupiter Saturn Square", "body": "The second half turns personal. Berkana reads Garton's chart for his first year as a father: a twelfth house profection year with the moon as time lord, eclipses on his Libra moon axis, a third house full of midwives and local support, and a Jupiter return in Gemini ruling his fifth house of children and creativity. She calls Jupiter in Gemini counter cultural rather than bad, a planet forced to borrow the tools of Mercury, and points to his puzzle art as proof. She then unpacks the first opening square of Jupiter and Saturn since their December 21, 2020 conjunction at zero degrees Aquarius."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Vibe Rant's own court astrologer, Kayleigh Berkana, returns to hang out and share some of the sky-clock knowledge & skills she's been developing since her last visit. We'll look at some of the recent events that have turned the world on its ear, through the astrology lens, along with what type of vibe climate we can expect for the coming months.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "You can consider Uranus to be much more like Prometheus, bringing the fire down from the gods to human mankind. I like to think of Uranus as the impulse towards individuality.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Whether or not we wanted to care about an event or anything, it was a visceral feeling of like an invading bad energy.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Our culture and what we call predictive programming might be working more to cause the event to happen than preparing us to see it a certain way.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Freedom is intrinsic to our soul and it doesn't matter what the big machine does.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's actually a protective nature to Algol as well because after Perseus beheads Medusa, it is used as a shield. So Algol is actually protective in nature if we use it consciously.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I assembled the crib and it said in the instructions requires two people. And I did the work of two people as one.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Mercury is all about the fine details, the letter of the law, you could say. Jupiter is about the spirit of the law, the philosophy of the law.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's edifying to catch yourself in your mistakes but it's also fortifying to forgive yourself those mistakes and just move on to what needs to be done now.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Everything that is old isn't necessarily bad, everything that is new isn't necessarily good and vice versa.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Instead, do some things to ground yourself and remember that most of the time, the scariest transits end up being nothing burgers for most people.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Telling you what you already know, but maybe there's too much dust in your eyes to notice, or it's too close. Like it's invisible by its proximity.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think the stoic position is just gonna be stick to what works for you and don't get caught up in the details.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}]
